main_defect: Self-test inconsistency: it reports 'Longest sentence: 23 words' but the check report finds a 28-word sentence ('It loses because a named logger lets the host quiet this module alone, at zero extra code'), which also breaks the 25-word description limit. The citation-order and multi-citation flags in the check report trace to code-block artifacts (e.g. parts[0] parsed as a citation), not to prose. All domain criteria are met: Clear domain correctly named, one-step deterministic actions with Gherkin tests, no questions, no hedges.

The check report flags a 28-word sentence on line 55 (exceeding the 25-word limit and contradicting the Self-test count of 23 words), and the one-line Cynefin domain reason given in Step 1 is not repeated on Steps 2 and 3.

Citation mechanics violate Section 5.4.1: the first citation to appear is [2] (in the Headline) before [1] (in Background), so numbering is out of order, and two rendered paragraphs carry more than one citation each ('Facts and level mapping' has [1] twice; 'Behavior notes' has [2] and [3] on one line). The check report's third failure (citation [0] with no reference) is a false positive from 'self.client_address[0]' in the code block. Otherwise the response is fully conformant and classifies the task correctly.
